**Timeline Baseline (EWMA Learn-Detect)**
Upload **normal traffic** pcap, system learns the network's 'daily profile' (packets/bytes/SYN/ports median per window),
then compare suspicious traffic against baseline, alert when deviation exceeds σ. Prebuilt `default` baseline ready to use.
